title: Pasatiempos y deportes
who: un nene de 10 (B1), frases medianas, errores de gramatica

transcripts.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are going on a fun adventure to talk about your favorite sports and hobbies. I love playing soccer! What is a sport or hobby that you really enjoy doing?
(sin respuesta)
Sometimes it is hard to pick just one! I really like running in the park too. Do you prefer playing soccer or maybe riding a bike?
I like riding a bike more because it is fun, but I also like play soccer with my friends. Sometimes I run in the park too.
That sounds awesome! So, you like playing soccer with your friends. It is great that you enjoy both activities! Do you think riding a bike is easier than playing soccer?
I think riding a bike is easier 'cause you can do it by yourself, but playing soccer is more fun with my friends.
That is a great point! I think that playing soccer is more fun with friends because you can work as a team. Do you agree that team sports are more exciting than individual ones?
